user.title: Set up Homio Dashboard
user.description: Homio Dashboard will be added to your sidebar. After setup, configure rooms and the logo under Configure / Add room.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single instance of Homio Dashboard is allowed.

create_entry.default: Homio is set up. Open the Homio sidebar item, then go to **Settings → Devices & Services → Homio** to **Configure** the logo and **Add room** for each space. Put room JPGs in `/config/homio/rooms/` and optional icons in `/config/homio/icons/`.

init.title: Homio options
init.description: Logo text, logo home room, navigation order, and header clock (format, AM/PM, tap action). Manage rooms via Add room / Configure on this integration.

data_description.logo_name: Shown in the Homio header (default HOMIO.).
data_description.logo_home_room: Room opened when tapping the logo. May be a room hidden from the nav list.
data_description.nav_order: Rooms shown in the header. Selection order is the navigation order (Select does not support drag-reorder).
data_description.clock_show_am_pm: When using 12-hour format, show AM/PM after the time.
data_description.clock_tap_action: What happens when the clock is tapped (same idea as a Lovelace card tap action).
data_description.clock_navigation_path: Used when tap action is Navigate (for example /lovelace/home or /homio_dashboard/living).
data_description.clock_url: Used when tap action is URL (opens in the browser).
data_description.clock_more_info_entity: Used when tap action is More info. Pick any entity; leave empty to do nothing.

user.title: Add room
user.description: Create a Homio room view. The URL path is derived from the nav name (e.g. Living → /homio_dashboard/living).

reconfigure.title: Configure room
reconfigure.description: Update this Homio room. The URL slug stays the same after first create.

room.title: Room details
room.description: Background image stem loads from /homio_assets/rooms/STEM.jpg (file under /config/homio/rooms/). Pick devices in dashboard order.

data_description.nav_name: Short label in the header / drawer (e.g. Living).
data_description.display_name: Large room title on the card (e.g. Living Room). Defaults to navigation name.
data_description.show_in_navigation: If off, the room is only reachable via logo (or direct URL), not the nav list.
data_description.devices: Entities shown on the room strip. Order is the card order. Card type is inferred from domain.

device_icons.title: Device customization
device_icons.description: Set a custom display name and icon for each device. Leave display name as the current name to keep the Home Assistant friendly name. Icon stem maps to /homio_assets/icons/STEM.svg under /config/homio/icons/.

abort.already_configured: A room with this path already exists.
